title: Prison Break
hook: How does Prison Break end? Michael's resurrection, Poseidon's downfall, and the revenge waiting in Fox River in the Season 5 finale, explained.

sections.heading: Michael, alive and trapped in Yemen
sections.body: The revival season opens seven years after Michael Scofield's apparent death, when strange clues suggest he may still be alive. Lincoln investigates and discovers Michael held in Ogygia Prison in Yemen under the alias Kaniel Outis, forced into the orbit of a shadowy intelligence figure known as Poseidon. The Season 5 finale resolves the question the season was built on: Michael is genuinely alive, and the closing episodes are about extracting him and exposing the man who faked his death and weaponised his engineering mind for off-the-books operations.

sections.heading: Unmasking and trapping Poseidon
sections.body: Poseidon is revealed to be Jacob Ness, the man Sara had married while believing Michael dead. In the finale Michael turns Jacob's own methods against him, luring Jacob and the agent A&W to a warehouse to recreate the murder of Gaines and prove Jacob's involvement on the record. The sting works: both Jacob and A&W are arrested. The plan exposes Poseidon as a rogue operator rather than a sanctioned one, dismantling the conspiracy that had framed Michael and kept him buried under a false identity halfway around the world.

sections.heading: Michael cleared, and a normal life
sections.body: With Theroux captured and forced to testify, and with planted evidence backing him up, Michael is finally exonerated of the crimes pinned on Kaniel Outis. Lincoln and Sara rescue Michael's son, Mike, completing the family's reunion. Offered a place inside the CIA for his proven talents, Michael refuses, choosing instead to return to an ordinary life with Sara and Mike. After five seasons defined by escapes and conspiracies, the finale grants Scofield the one thing the franchise never let him keep: a quiet existence free of the people hunting him.

sections.heading: T-Bag's grim favor in Fox River
sections.body: The finale settles its scores with characteristic cruelty. Whip is shot by A&W and dies, and in retaliation T-Bag kills A&W and is arrested for it. Michael then arranges for Jacob Ness to be sent to Fox River State Penitentiary, where he is placed in a cell with T-Bag, exactly as Michael requested. The closing beat shows the other inmates cheering T-Bag on as he attacks Jacob, delivering Poseidon to a punishment outside the courts. It is a final, brutal piece of Scofield engineering, turning the prison that started the saga into Jacob's cage.

final_image: Jacob Ness is delivered to Fox River as T-Bag's cellmate, the inmates cheering as T-Bag turns on him, while Michael walks free into a normal life with Sara and Mike.

lingering_questions.q: Is Michael Scofield alive at the end of Prison Break?
lingering_questions.a: Yes. The Season 5 revival reveals he survived his apparent death and was held in Yemen under the alias Kaniel Outis. He is rescued, exonerated, and returns to a normal life with Sara and their son Mike.

lingering_questions.q: Who is Poseidon and what happens to him?
lingering_questions.a: Poseidon is Jacob Ness, Sara's husband. Michael traps him into exposing his crimes, gets him arrested, then arranges for him to be sent to Fox River as T-Bag's cellmate, where T-Bag attacks him.
